decisions.reason: The repeatedly gold-medalled premium raisin stollen is the firm's flagship, and its value is largely confirmed, so further commitment rather than abandonment is justified.
After three sibling breads were pruned, the dark malt rye bread survived as the retained rye option, and its low holding cost and still-uncertain demand justify keeping it open another year.
The marzipan stollen complements the flagship stollen line seasonally at minimal cost, so keeping the option open through another Christmas season is sensible.
